title: Texans K Ka'imi Fairbairn agrees to two-year extension

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Texans K Ka'imi Fairbairn agrees to two-year extension
sources.description: The Texans already had kicker Ka'imi Fairbairn under contract for 2026 and they've made a move to make sure he'll be around beyond next season as well.
